The '''third moon of Kothlis''' was a [[Moon/Legends|satellite]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] named [[Maja]] crash-landed on the moon in a [[Tech 4 PDV]]. A group of adventurers soon approached him to recover information on the vessel. Maja negotiated with the strangers and sold the vessel.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
